headline: Approved Magnolia 525 Tavern's request to extend its alcohol service area onto the sidewalk for Magtoberfest, 2-0.
summary: Larry Rodolosi of Magnolia Oceanside, dba Magnolia 525 Tavern, asked to put six tables on the sidewalk in front of the restaurant for outdoor dining during Magtoberfest. The request covers serving food and alcohol on October 11, 2026, and there is no rain date.
decisions: Approved the application of Larry Rodolosi of Magnolia Oceanside, dba Magnolia 525 Tavern, to extend its alcohol service area to serve food and alcohol on October 11, 2026, during Magtoberfest, 2-0.

plain_text:
CITY OF GLOUCESTER 
LICENSING BOARD REMOTE SPECIAL MEETING 
 
 
Meeting Minutes  
September 28, 2026 
 
 
Board Members Present: 
 
Melissa J. Teixeira Prince, Chairperson  
John Lamirande  
 
Also in Attendance: 
Natasha Dale, Licensing Board Clerk  
Rob Vicari, Building Commissioner  
 
Absent: 
Ted Costa 
 
 
The Chair Calls to Order the Quorum of the Licensing Board at 6:01 PM. 
 
The Chair reads the following statement; 
 Effective August 16, 2023 the public is welcome to attend our meetings in person. 
Alternatively, the public may attend through the zoom link listed on the agenda. The 
meeting notice will reflect if this a meeting of zoom only. As the recent amendments to 
the Open Meeting Law allows the Committee can continue to hold the meeting remotely. 
Please note that the in person meeting will not be suspended or terminated if 
technological problems interrupt the remote connection.  
 
Extension of Premise: 
 
Larry Rodolosi of Magnolia Oceanside, dba Magnolia 525 Tavern is requesting to extend 
his alcohol service area to serve food and alcohol on October 11, 2026 during 
Magtoberfest. 
 
Larry Rodolosi, 12 Lloyd St., Gloucester is present. 
 
Mr. Rodolosi is requesting to put 6 tables out front of the restaurant on the sidewalk for 
outdoor dining during the annual Magtoberfest.  
 
Signs will be put up for people to not walk away with alcohol. There is no rain date for 
this event.
Ms. Prince moves to approve the application of Larry Rodolosi of Magnolia Oceanside, 
dba Magnolia 525 Tavern requesting to extend his alcohol service area to serve food and 
alcohol on October 11, 2026 during Magtoberfest. 
 
Mr. Lamirande seconds 
All in favor, 2-0 
Adjournment:  
 
Ms. Prince moves to adjourn at: 6:06 PM 
Mr. Lamirande seconds 
All in favor, 2-0
